book.title: Na Matiu A Lagasai Roxo Na Matiu A Xaleie

content: A Ferawaian Paap Sena Mataa Tataraꞌuma
La yaan naang, na Yesus a taꞌulan a lifu aave e fe nai la vangana Laman Galili xena fepitaa.
Nane xawas xuluna xaati senaso a malila ri ti fakaliuane xena langai sina. Nane nai la xaati e mu rabuna ri tigina la gun.
Nane fapiti nari pana maana mo xaves e xavang famasam nari pana maana ferawaian paap. Nane kuus, “Saxa yaan a mataa tataraꞌuma a falet la uma sina xena tapalan a mu kam.
E layaan i taxa tapalan a mu kam, saxano kam ri poxo la salan e mu maanu ri maa ngan xapine.
Saxanofuna ri poxo lapi la bina faat e piau ta xavala xaves. E a mu kam aave ri boak fataapus.
Taasaxa layaan a ngaas a savat fulaa, a nuk a maana mo xurul e ri femaiyang senaso a xarei iri pife fexaxaas.
Saxanofuna fulaa ri poxo la xavala xuvul pana kam ina yeis tuturuk. E mu tuturuk aave ri boak fataapus e a kam ina ‘wiit’ pife fexaxaas sena faꞌoname.
Taasaxa saxano kam ri poxo la xavala roxo e ri fasavat a mu kam xaves: saxanofuna a kam xaves e saxanofuna a kam xaves paaliu.”
E na Yesus a kuus, “Langai, tamo a tangami a talakas.”
E mui a mu fefeng sina ri fe waan la tana e ri fine, “Senasou no fuuna lo ferawai paap xe sina mu rabuna?”
E na Yesus a sui nari, “A Piran fo tavai nami pana masaman sena mo fufunai ina fatataganan sina, taasaxa xe siri, piau.

A mo aanabeꞌ a tuuna, senaso a mataa aava toxan a masaman i taa toxan a masaman molava. E a masaman sina i taa fexaxaas sena e i taa pesasoliu. E nane aava piau ta mo, a so ta mo modak aava nane toxane i taa siak tapinan.
Nabeꞌ ve a fufuna ferawaian paap siak:

content.text: ‘Ri kaalum taasaxa ri pife taraxali a so ta mo ri taxa xalume. E ri langai a maana vapaling ri laak la tangari taasaxa ri bai langai e ri pife masam.’ Isi 12:2

content: E voxo a kuus fatuxaian si Aisaia a ferawai seri malaan:

content.text: ‘A mu rabuna aanabeꞌ ri taa langai
taasaxa ri taa pife masam, ri taa kaalum taasaxa ri taa pife taraxali
a so ta mo ri taxa xalume
senaso a lamonan siri a sopat e ri pife fexaxaas sena siak a texaasan.
Ri vil votan a tangari talo ri taa pife langai e ri xafut a matari talo ri taa pife kaalum.
Tamo ri pife vil malaane ri tamaa kaalum pana matari, langai pana tangari e masam la xunus iri e puk a vilaana siri e ne taa vil faroxoi nari.’ Ais 6:9,10

content: “Taasaxa waanan simi a roxo paaliu senaso a Piran fo tiuan a roxoyan sina xulumi. E a matami ri kaalum famatavas e tangami ri langai pana masaman.
A tuuna, ne xuus nami o mu rabuna ina kuus fatuxai e maana rabuna sina Piran ti kavai, ri buk xalum a maana mo mi xalume e langai a maana mo mi langaie, taasaxa piau.
Na Yesus A Kuus Famatavas Pana Malasuf Ina Ferawaian Paap Sena Mataa Tataraꞌuma
“Langai xo e masam sena malasuf ina ferawaian paap sena mataa tataraꞌuma.

Nari aava ri langai a lagasai ina fatataganan sina Piran taasaxa ri pife masam xapine, ri malaan sena mu kam aava ri poxo la salan. Na Setan, a Mataa Saat, maa savat e pagas tapin a lagasai aave ti lana xunus iri.
E nari aava ri tao a lagasai pana faamamaasan layaan ri langaie, ri malaan sena mu kam aava ri poxo la bina faat.
Taasaxa a lagasai aave pife waan fatateak la xunus iri e ri usi famodaxe mon. Layaan a lagafan o vil penganan a savat la toyan siri senaso ri namkai sena lagasai aave, ri taꞌulan fatapusane.

E nari aava ri langai a lagasai aanabeꞌ ri malaan sena mu kam aava ri poxo la palou ina mu yeis tuturuk. Taasaxa ri lamon faaxaves pana maana mo ina toyan siri e ri vubuxan temasaatan a faat e maana mo ri taa maraane e mu vilaana aanabeꞌ ri kawaasan a lagasai aave talo i taa pife fasavat a vilaana roxo.

E nari aava ri langai a lagasai aave pana masaman, ri malaan sena mu kam aava mataa tataraꞌuma tapalane la xavala roxo. Ri taa fasavat a maana faisok roxo malaan sena kam aava fuaa pana mu kam xaves e xaves paaliu.”
A Ferawaian Paap Pana Mu Latan
Na Yesus a xuus nari pana xasa ferawaian paap fulaa: “A fatataganan sina Piran a malaanabeꞌ. A mataa tataraꞌuma a tapalan a mu kam roxo la uma lava sina.
Saxa vung xo layaan a mu rabuna ri taxa matef, a xaiyaas sina mataa aave maa savat xena xapis a latan la palou ina kam roxo e falet faapalau.
Layaan a mu kam ri boak e fuaa, a latan vaxa a boak e fuaa.
“E a mu sisiak sina mataa aave ri maa savat sina e ri fine, ‘Matalava, no xapis a uma lava siim pana kam roxo. A latan a savat ti faa?’
“E nane sui nari, ‘Saxa xaiyaas siak fo vile.’ E ri fine, ‘No vubuk rao maam taa fe put tapin a latan aave?’
“Taasaxa a sui nari, ‘Piau, layaan mi put a latan mi tamaa put a kam roxo aava fo boak vaxa.

Taꞌulan a kam roxo e a latan xena savat faxuvul fefexaxaas a yaan ina faxuvulaana. E lana yaan aave ne taa xuus a mu rabuna ina faisok siak o ri taa put tapin a latan paamua e pis faxuvule xena farame, e mui ri taa faxuvul a kam ina ‘wiit’ e faneie la lifu ina fawaanaana fanganan.”
A Ferawaian Paap Pana Kam Modak Aava Ri Xalie Pana Mastaat
Na Yesus a xuus nari pana ferawaian paap fulaa: “A fatataganan sina Piran a malaan sena kam ina mastaat aava mataa a siaxe e fe xapise la uma sina.
A kam ina wai mastaat a pemamodak sena xasano buk kam taasaxa layaan fo boak a pemolava sena maana buk latan e fasavat a wai talo mu maanu ri maa vesan a mu singa siri la raxana.”
A Ferawaian Paap Sena Yiis Aava Fasul A Flaua
Na Yesus a xuus nari pana ferawaian paap fulaa laa: “E a fatataganan sina Piran a malaan sena yiis aava tefin a siaxe e salate pana flaua lana bi titifai talatul fefexaxaas a flaua xurul fesul.”
A Fufuna Mu Ferawaian Paap Si Yesus
Na Yesus a ferawai paap xe siri xena xuus nari pana maana mo xapiak aanabeꞌ. Nane pife ferawai xe siri pana piau ta ferawaian paap.
A savat malaan xena faxalit a mo aava mataa ina kuus fatuxai fo ferawai pana:

content.text: “Layaan ne ferawai xe siri ne taa ferawai paap mon.
Ne taa xuus nari pana maana mo aava waan fufunai
la tangpat ina maana mo xapiak.” Yng 78:2

content: Na Yesus A Kuusan Famatavas A Malasuf Ina Ferawaian Paap Pana Latan
Layaan na Yesus fo taꞌulan a malila e fe laak la lifu, a mu fefeng sina ri savat sina e ri kuus, “Xuus famatavas nemaam pana malasuf ina ferawaian paap sena latan la uma lava.”
E na Yesus a sui nari, “A mataa aava tapalan a mu kam roxo la uma sina, nane ve a Natuna Mataa.
A uma lava va xavala e a kam roxo va mu rabuna aava ri waan la fatata- ganan sina Piran. A latan va mu rabuna aava ri waan la fatataganan sina mataa saat
e a xaiyaas aava xapis a latan, nane ve na Setan. A yaan ina faxuvulan ve a fataxapiak ina yaan e a mu rabuna ina faisok lana faxuvulan aave va mu angelo.
“E malaan sena latan a put tapinan e faraman lana fata, lana yaan fataxapiak i taa malaan:
a Natuna Mataa i taa feng a mu angelo sina e ri taa put tapin nari aava ri vil familung a rabuna e nari xapiak aava ri vil a mo mosaat ti lana fatataganan sina.
E ri taa tapin fasivi nari lana vaaꞌul pana fata lava e pave ri taa taangiis faagut e faxakengatan a fari.
E mui a rabuna fatak ri taa rarapak malaan sena ngaas lana fatataganan si Tamari. Langai xo tamo tangami a talakas.
Ferawaian Paap Sena Fafanaian Fufunai

“A fatataganan sina Piran a malaan sena fafanaian roxo paaliu aava funan la uma. Saxa mataa a tingin a fafanaian aave e fun fulane. Nane faamamaas paaliu e fe faasot pana maana mo xapiak sina xena maraan a uma aave.
Ferawaian Paap Sena Saxa Xixiut ‘Purl’ Aava Roxo
“E vaxa, a fatataganan sina Piran a malaan sena saxa mataa ina faasot aava i taxa seng a mu xixiut roxo paaliu aava ri xalie pana ‘purl’.
E layaan a tingin a saxa aava roxo paaliu marasaxa, a fe faasot pana maana mo xapiak sina xena maraan a xixiut aave.
A Ferawaian Paap Sena Vana
“E fulaa a fatataganan sina Piran a malaan sena saxano rabuna ina faadin aava ri tapin fasivi a vana siri pe la laman e a maana buk din xaves ri fai lana.
Layaan a vana siri a bas pana din ri yuuf falaxe xe la gun e ri maa fepatoxan a mu din. A maana din roxo ri fawaane lana mu bi e maana din aava ri pife fexaxaas sena ngane ri tapine.
I taa waan malaan la fataxapiak ina yaan. A mu angelo ri taa falet xolai xena fepatoxan a mu rabuna saat xasena mu rabuna fatak.
E ri taa tapin nari xe lana vaaꞌul pana fata lava e pave ri taa taangiis faagut e faxakengatan a fari.”
Na Yesus a fiai, “Mi fo masam pana maana mo aanabeꞌ, bo?” E ri suie, “Aang!”

E a sui nari, “Lavaxa, a rabuna ina fepitaa pana vuputkai aava ri fawaan nari xa lapaana tateaxan ina fatataganan sina Piran, ri malaan sena mataa tafuna lifu aava siak fasavat a maana mo faꞌui e maana mo xavai ti lana nobina ina fawaanaana maana mo sina.”
A Mu Nasaret Ri Gigiran Na Yesus
E layaan na Yesus fo taxapus pana mu ferawaian paap aanabeꞌ a taꞌulan a bina aave

e ulaa xe pe la fufubina sina. E fe lo fapiti nari lana mu lifu ina faxuvulan siri e nari aava ri langaie, ri ipul sena e ri fiai, “Nane siak a texaasan molava faa? Nane vil a maana mo faꞌipul malaafaa?
Taara texaas sena. Nane a lak sina mataa ina vavesai. E na ninana, na Maria e mu tina ve na Jems, Yosep, Simon e na Juut
e mu vasaana vaxa ri taxa waan iau. Nane siak a texaasan e gutan aanabeꞌ ti faa?”
E voxo ri gigirane. Taasaxa na Yesus a xuus nari, “A mu rabuna la xasano bina ri taa suai sena mataa ina kuus fatuxai taasaxa nari ti la fufubina sina e la matafetama sina, piau.”
E nane pife vil a maana mo faꞌipul pave senaso ri pife namkai sena.
